title: Write a SQL query finding products never ordered.
prompt: Write a SQL query finding products never ordered.
solution_code:
SELECT p.product_id, p.name
-- products with no orders
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items o ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.product_id IS NULL;
explanation: A left join plus a null check isolates products with no matching order rows. It handles edge cases cleanly.
